name: Eminent
marques: Anyone making a Looking Deeper roll to detect this object gains +1 tier.
notes: no marques; 25 princes
text:
An eminent object radiates its spiritual qualities very clearly. When making a Looking Deeper roll, anybody who is attempting to detect the object will gain 1 tier to their roll.
Cost to Buy: no marques, can be learned by anyone with the Mementos specialty; commonly 25 princes.

name: Shrouded
marques: Anyone making a Looking Deeper roll to detect this object loses 1 tier.
notes: no marques; 25 princes
text:
A shrouded object hides its spiritual qualities within itself, making it difficult to detect. When making a Looking Deeper roll, anybody who is attempting to detect the object will lose 1 tier from their roll.
Cost to Buy: no marques, can be learned by anyone with the Mementos specialty; commonly 25 princes.

name: Boon
marques: With Ace Up My Sleeve, a natural 11 may be stored as if it were a 12.
notes: no marques; 625 princes; used with Ace Up My Sleeve
text:
Used with the Ace Up My Sleeve specialty.
Those who carry around a boon memento are capable of catching twice as much luck. When the holder of an item augmented with boon rolls a natural 11, if that person has the Ace Up My Sleeve specialty, they may store it as if it were a 12.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

modifiers.label: Boon: natural 11 storable as 12 (Ace Up My Sleeve)

name: Bullet-Avoiding
notes: choose a called-shot location when augmenting
text: Circumstance can save the groin of the holder of an object with the bullet-avoiding augment. When you augment your memento, choose a called shot location (such as your groin or head). When the holder of such an item is attacked with a called shot in that location, they gain a bonus to evade the attack.

modifiers.label: vs. called shots to the chosen location

name: Enhanced Spirit
text: This augment causes the item to link to the user's driving force, enhancing and reinforcing it with the innate spiritual power of the item. Whenever the holder makes a Spirit roll, they gain a bonus from this augment.

name: Flamewalker
text: Objects augmented with the flamewalker augment prevent the user from catching fire as badly. Whenever the holder of a flamewalker-augmented item catches fire, they may roll their die. If their roll exceeds a certain number, the tier of the fire is decreased by 1.

name: Fortune
notes: once between downtimes in a public area, even roll → money; narrator adjusts to the location
text:
The holder of an object augmented to be fortunate will find that money sometimes just finds its way into their possession. Once in-between downtimes, when the holder goes into a public area, they may roll a die. If the result is even, then they receive money from this augment based on its marque.
Note to the narrator: rough guideline based on a typical working-class town; a deserted wasteland yields less, ritzier parts of a city more. Fortune doesn't always play fair.

name: Heroism
text: Linking in with the holder's driving force, items augmented with heroism cause the user's bursts of heroic vigor to be even more powerful. When the holder makes a Spirit roll for heroism, that person gains a bonus to their roll from this augment.

name: Hex Holder
notes: used with Curse
text:
Used with the Curse specialty.
A hex-holding memento stores your failures, your anxieties, and your evil whims. Any wielder of a hex-holding item who has the Curse specialty can hold an additional 1 per the marque of the hex holder augment. Rolls of 1 that are held in this way follow all of the other rules of 1's held by the Curse specialty.

name: "Hey, a Coin!"
marques: +6 on the evade roll when ambushed
+8 on the evade roll when ambushed
+10 on the evade roll when ambushed
+12 on the evade roll when ambushed
text: It is said that finding a coin on the ground grants a bit of luck somewhere down the line. Any time the holder would be ambushed such that the initial attack would go straight to wounds, the holder notices a coin on the ground. Picking up the coin grants a bonus to evade and a coin of the narrator's choice (most commonly a quarter- or eighth-duke in Trust-run economies).

name: High Roller
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; used with Jackpot
text:
Used with the Jackpot specialty.
When the holder of your item makes a lucky break, they hit it extra lucky. If the holder of a high roller memento has the Jackpot specialty, activating the specialty causes them to gain additional damage class based on the marque of this augment.

name: Illogical Traps
marques: Roll must exceed or be equal to 8
Roll must exceed or be equal to 6
Roll must exceed or be equal to 4
text: When you would be setting off a trap that you don't know about, roll the die. If your die roll exceeds the required roll (according to the augment's marques), the trap doesn't go off for you. It will, unfortunately, still probably go off for the next guy who activates it, or if you interact with it again.

name: Keen
text: An item that is augmented to make the user keen causes that person to be still and precise, by whatever means, allowing the character to hit more accurately. Holding an object with this augment will cause the user to have a bonus on all accuracy rolls.

name: Lucky Breaks
marques: 1 AP reflexive: change one of your own rolls by 1 (impure; 1–12).
notes: no marques; 125 princes; Cost: 1 AP reflexive
text:
Cost: 1 AP reflexively
For 1 action point reflexively, the holder of a lucky breaks item may change the result of any of their own rolls by 1 point – however, this makes that roll impure, meaning that it cannot be used for specialties which interact with rolls of a certain number (such as the Curse specialty) or operate under normal rolling rules (an impure 1 does not deny bonuses, and an impure 12 does not explode). Rolls modified in this way may not be decreased below 1 or increased above 12.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 125 princes.

name: Magical Numbers
notes: takes 3 slots
text:
Takes up 3 augment slots on a memento.
The number 3 is a low number, all things considered, but that does not stop it from often holding a mystical or magical quality. For the holder of a magical number memento, all specialty or attribute rolls of 3 gain a bonus based on the marque of this augment.

modifiers.label: bonus on natural rolls of 3 (Magical Numbers)

name: Moments of Clarity
text: Things have trouble staying out of sight of someone holding your item. Stray twigs underfoot, a fortuitous gust of wind, a glinting piece of metal – these fortuitous events cause hidden items to be more evident. When making a Cunning roll to notice, the holder of this memento gains a bonus.

name: Moneymaker
marques: In gambling games: re-roll a die or re-draw a card once per turn of the game (the re-do is final).
notes: no marques; 125 princes
text:
Carried by some of the more lucrative gamblers, this item significantly increases a person's chance at winning any kind of money-betting game. When the holder plays a game involving gambling, he or she may re-roll any die roll or re-draw any undesirable card once per turn of that game. Any re-draw is final; if the second roll or draw is worse than the first, the holder is stuck with it.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 125 princes.

name: Master of Fortune
marques: With Moneymaker: choose which outcome (original or re-done) to keep.
notes: no marques; 625 princes; requires Moneymaker on the same memento
text:
Requires: Moneymaker augment on the memento
The pinnacle of excellence in gambling, the best way to win games of fortune is to get to choose your outcome. When you opt to re-draw or re-roll via the moneymaker augment, you may choose which outcome – the original or re-done – that you will use. Some gamblers and gambling operations will not take kindly to characters who win too many games.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

name: Near Misses
marques: Prevents the effects of a Called Shot
Prevents the effects of a Wound
Prevents the effects of a Fatal Injury
notes: Cost: 2 AP reflexive; consumable (removed from the item after one use)
text:
Cost: 2 AP reflexively
Sometimes, the greatest statement of luck comes not from what fortune you have, but by the bad things that do not happen to you. An item that is augmented with the near misses augment will protect its user – once – from receiving personal injury. For 2 action points reflexively, the holder may prevent the effects of a Called Shot, Wound, or Fatal Effect, depending on the marque of this object. This is a consumable augment: when used once, it disappears from the item permanently.

name: Pocket Aces
notes: used with Ace Up My Sleeve
text:
Used with the Ace Up My Sleeve specialty.
Your item helps you keep your good luck about you. Any wielder of a pocket aces item who has the Ace Up My Sleeve specialty may hold an additional 12 per the marque of this augment. Rolls of 12 held in this way follow all of the other rules of 12's held by the Ace Up My Sleeve specialty.

name: Silver Tongue
marques: +2 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
+4 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
+6 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
+8 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
text: An item augmented with silver tongue builds upon the user's wit and empathy. The holder can more easily read and react to others, gaining a bonus to all rolls for social tells and any other social Cunning rolls.

name: Surprising Finesse
marques: +1 tier on the Dexterity roll to prevent Wounds damage from falling.
notes: no marques; 125 princes
text:
When the holder finds themselves falling, that character gains a bonus of 1 tier to the dexterity roll made to prevent Wounds damage from hitting the ground.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 125 princes.

name: Uncanny Efficiency
notes: no marques; 125 princes
text:
The object causes the user to craft with exceptional efficiency and ease, allowing for the creation of more objects from scratch, using the same amount of time and materials. A holder of an item with the uncanny efficiency augment gains 1 DIY.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 125 princes.

name: Untouchable Location
marques: Chosen called-shot location: random called shot/wound/fatal hitting it is re-rolled once (second result stands).
notes: no marques; 25 princes; choose a called-shot location when augmenting
text:
When the item is augmented, the person making the memento chooses a called-shot location. If any random called shot roll, wound, or fatal causes that location to be targeted, then the roller instead re-rolls and takes the second roll – if that roll lands on the same location, then the location will be hit regardless of this augment.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 25 princes.

name: Utility
notes: only rolls using the augmented object itself
text: Your object manages to make itself useful in its own way, more so than another object of its kind. Any non-combat roll to use the augmented object gains a bonus from this augment.

name: Win Some, Lose Some
text: Messing up doesn't always have to be that bad; for the holder it can be somewhat invigorating. When the holder of an item with this augment rolls a natural 1, they gain hit points.

name: Blank Stare
marques: Tier 2 Cunning to resist, -2 to the next Social Tells roll
Tier 2 Cunning to resist, -4 to the next Social Tells roll
Tier 3 Cunning to resist, -6 to the next Social Tells roll
Tier 3 Cunning to resist, -8 to the next Social Tells roll
notes: Resist: Cunning
text:
Resist: Cunning
A common curse placed on the belongings of socialites. When the holder of an item augmented with blank stare rolls a natural 1 on any Cunning roll to interact with people or for social tells, that person must make a resist or be sent into a brief stupor, staring off blankly into space as they lose track of what they were going to say and taking penalties to the following Social Tells roll.

name: Bottom Rung
marques: Holder always loses ties (cancels an ability that wins ties).
notes: no marques; 625 princes
text:
Ordinarily, the offender will win ties in a matched roll. However, holders of items augmented with bottom rung always lose ties. If the holder has an ability that causes them to win ties, then both abilities negate each other for the duration of holding the augmented item.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

name: Butterfingers
text: Things just have a tendency to slip from the hands of the holder of a butterfingers item. When one such person attempts to draw any kind of potion during battle, that person must roll a d12 with no bonuses. If the roll does not exceed the number designated by the marque of this augment, then the person drops that potion and it crashes to the ground. (Gases will still probably go off, and acids might eat through the ground.)

name: Cruel Fate
marques: Natural 2s deny bonuses like natural 1s (abilities that let 1s keep bonuses also apply to 2s).
notes: no marques; 2,500 princes; takes 4 slots (needs Objects of Fortune)
text:
Takes up 4 augment slots on a memento.
An item augmented in this way is truly intended to be the death of the user. As long as the item is held by the user, whenever that person rolls a natural 2, it denies bonuses to that character in the same way that natural rolls of 1 do. Any specialty or other ability that causes rolls of 1 to allow bonuses also allows rolls of 2 to provide bonuses (e.g. the Free from Failure specialty).
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 2,500 princes.

name: Eau de Bile
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; Resist: Spirit; only placeable after a successful called shot to the holder's groin
text:
Resist: Spirit
An embarrassing curse to place on an enemy. This augment can only be placed on an object after making a successful called shot to the groin of the holder of your item of choice. Whenever the opponent takes a wound or fatal effect, regardless of the location, they suddenly find themselves in a state of acute nausea. The person must make a Spirit resist, or he will purge for 1 turn.

name: Extra-Combustible
marques: When the holder catches fire: roll without bonuses; odd → fire +1 tier.
notes: no marques; 625 princes
text:
Fire has an affinity for whoever holds an object with this curse. When the holder of an item augmented with extra-combustible catches on fire, they must roll a die with no bonuses. If the result is odd, then the fire immediately goes up by 1 tier.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

name: Fumble
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; Resist: Spirit; requires Hand Slip augment
text:
Resist: Spirit
Requires: Hand Slip augment
One of the few things more dangerous than dropping your weapon during a battle is accidentally attacking yourself. The holder of an item augmented with the fumble curse will make an attack on himself with tier 1 damage any time that he rolls a 1 for accuracy unless he can make a Spirit resist.

name: Hand Slip
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; Resist: Spirit; requires the Feeling Lucky specialty
text:
Resist: Spirit
Requires: Feeling Lucky specialty known
A slip of the hand can be a deadly mistake in battle. When the holder of a hand slip augmented item rolls a natural 1 on any accuracy roll, they must make a resist versus the tier of this augment or drop the weapon they're using.

name: Ignorance is Bliss
text: Sometimes, ignorance is bliss. These are not those times. When the holder of this memento is engaged in a situation where things go badly, they are just not quite all there to react quickly. Whenever the holder is rolling priority at the beginning of battle, that character receives a priority penalty based on the marque of this augment.

name: Insomnia
marques: -2 to Cunning rolls to Gather Intel
-4 to Cunning rolls to Gather Intel
-6 to Cunning rolls to Gather Intel
-8 to Cunning rolls to Gather Intel
text: Your item causes happenstance to disrupt the subject's sleeping – a bug chirping outside the window, an early morning call, et cetera. When the holder is trying to think clearly in order to solve puzzles or make connections, they take a penalty to their Cunning.

name: Lead Tongue
marques: -2 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
-4 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
-6 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
-8 to Cunning rolls for Social Tells
text: This augment causes the user to stumble upon all the wrong responses and conclusions when talking. Whenever the holder of a lead tongue memento is trying to make a social tells roll or otherwise rolling a Cunning roll to be social, that person takes a penalty from the item.

name: Lost Wallet
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; Resist: Cunning
text:
Resist: Cunning
Whenever the holder of an item with this augment attempts to go shopping, they must roll. If the roll comes out to a natural 1, then that person has left their wallet (or other means of carrying money) at the most recent location where they were. The person may roll a Cunning resist any time this occurs versus this augment.

name: Lost & Stolen
marques: When Lost Wallet activates, the wallet is lost and stolen.
notes: no marques; 625 princes; Resist: Cunning (see Lost Wallet); requires Lost Wallet on the same memento
text:
Resist: Cunning (see the "Lost Wallet" augment)
Requires: Lost Wallet augment on the memento
When the lost wallet curse activates on the victim of this item, the wallet will have indeed been lost and stolen, rendering it much more difficult to get a hold of.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

name: Malfunctioning Weapons
marques: Anyone sundering the holder's weapons gains +1 tier on a successful sunder roll.
notes: no marques; 125 princes
text:
A crippling curse to place on a soldier or duelist. When someone attempts to break a weapon held by the holder of this item, the assailant gains 1 tier to any successful sunder roll against the holder's weapons.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 125 princes.

name: Obscurity
text: Your item muddles the location of things to the holder, making them hide, sometimes even in plain sight. When the holder of an object augmented with obscurity makes a Cunning roll to Notice, they take a penalty on that roll.

name: Planted Cards
marques: Roll must be 2 or higher, otherwise people notice; Tier 2 Cunning resists
Roll must be 4 or higher, otherwise people notice; Tier 2 Cunning resists
Roll must be 6 or higher, otherwise people notice; Tier 3 Cunning resists
Roll must be 8 or higher, otherwise people notice; Tier 3 Cunning resists
notes: Resist: Cunning
text:
Resist: Cunning
When the holder is playing a card game of any kind, they must roll their die. Depending on how well they roll, they might make their way through the game with nobody noticing the cards sticking out of their sleeve. If they fail... let's hope they're playing with good-natured people. The character can make a Cunning resist versus this augment.

name: Slippery Fingers
text: An item augmented with slippery fingers causes the holder to be fidgety and unclear, preventing that character from hitting as accurately. Holding an object with this augment will cause the user to have a penalty to all accuracy rolls.

name: Space Out
marques: -3 to Cunning rolls to notice ambushes
-6 to Cunning rolls to notice ambushes
-9 to Cunning rolls to notice ambushes
-12 to Cunning rolls to notice ambushes
text: A rough curse to have placed on one's belongings in guerrilla warfare. When rolling Cunning to notice if there is an impending ambush, the person takes a penalty from this augment.

name: Stupid Sciences
marques: -1 tier on any roll to use or control a Beta item made with Sciences crafting.
notes: no marques; 625 princes
text:
The holder of this item suffers a great deal of confusion upon picking up and trying to understand any Beta item, receiving one less tier on any roll made to use or control a Beta item made with crafting from Sciences.
Cost to Buy: no marques; commonly 625 princes.

name: Wacky Widgets
notes: Resist: Sciences; once between breathers
text:
Resist: Sciences
When the holder of a wacky widgets item tries to activate any item crafted with Sciences, they must roll a Sciences resist or they will spend several turns treating every item as if it were a Beta item. This only happens once between breathers.

name: Wardrobe Malfunction
notes: two marques: mQ I, mQ III from 15 Luck; Resist: Spirit
text:
Resist: Spirit
When the holder of a wardrobe malfunction item rolls a natural 1 on any Cunning roll for social tells or other kinds of interaction with other people, they must then roll a Spirit resist or have their clothing open itself in the most humiliating of ways.

name: Weak Soul
text: Weak soul items drain their holder of driving force, decreasing the person's willpower. When the holder of an item augmented with weak soul makes a Spirit roll of any kind, they take a penalty to the roll from the augment.
